slice: S165 — the render-farm determinism + throughput slice
law: The golden harness (scripts/s87-acceptance-battery.mts Part D) renders the SAME deterministic fixture per engine and holds the delivered bytes to the COMMITTED baseline within these committed tolerances: per-frame PSNR floor (minPsnr), allowed frames below that floor (maxFrameFailures), and the audio Pearson correlation floor (minAudioCorrelation; null = the fixture carries no audio). A pixel change that matters lands far BELOW the PSNR floor; codec/build drift lands far above it. A DELIBERATE visual change re-baselines on purpose: node --import tsx scripts/s87-acceptance-battery.mts --only=D --write-golden — that commit IS the review moment this harness exists to force.

engines.fixture: scaffoldGraphicsDoc — the pure native rule-table scaffold (the production degradation floor), deliberately NOT scaffoldGraphicsDocLlm: without a provided `call` that planner dials the real gateway when the environment carries keys, and a golden fixture must be deterministic by construction. One scene ('The golden frame' / 'one two three four five'), 640x360 @24fps, a 220Hz sine music bed mixed at the house gains. Deterministic: rule-table picks, no network, no randomness, no clock.
